title: Titanium Dental Abutment (Angled)
alloyReason: ASTM F136 Ti-6Al-4V ELI is specified for Titanium Dental Abutment (Angled) as an implant-grade material where controlled interstitial chemistry delivers consistent fatigue strength (>600 MPa @ 10^7 cycles) and crevice corrosion resistance for permanent implantation. The restricted aluminum (5.5-6.5%) and vanadium (3.5-4.5%) ranges ensure reproducible mechanical performance for Custom multi-unit angled dental abutment. This rationale is driven by custom multi-unit angled dental abutment and service environment demands.

Ultrasonic clean Class 10k with Class 6g gauge

commonFailures: Fe contamination from machining - requires acid passivation 20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C per ASTM F86 — critical for custom multiunit angled performance

faq.q: Is Titanium Dental Abutment (Angled) MRI-safe or MRI-conditional?
faq.a: Ti-6Al-4V ELI is non-ferromagnetic (magnetic susceptibility 1.00005 × 10⁻⁶ cgs) and generates negligible MRI artifact compared to 316L stainless steel. Titanium Dental Abutment (Angled) is classified as MR-Conditional under ASTM F2052/F2213 testing at 1.5T and 3.0T field strengths. Specific absorption rates remain within safe limits for custom multiunit angled configurations.

faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Dental Abutment (Angled) is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Dental Abutment (Angled)?
faq.a: Each Titanium Dental Abutment (Angled) shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for custom multiunit angled.
